data.long_meaning: Eshaan is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ishaan', which means 'Lord Shiva'. This name is deeply rooted in Hindu mythology and is a tribute to the supreme deity, Lord Shiva. Eshaan is believed to bring good luck, prosperity, and strength to the one who bears this name. The name Eshaan carries the meaning “Lord Shiva” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Eshaan usually hope their child will grow to embody lord shiva and live with faith, good character and purpose.
